The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need for a more systematic approach to incorporating behavioral economics into regulatory benefit estimation, one that would provide more consistent, defensible, and justifiable benefit estimates.
a behavioral transfer test should precede the adoption of any behavioral findings from narrow context to broad policy application.
